name: praeko-js
description: Praeko client code: @praeko/sdk, @praeko/cli and the Praeko Studio (@praeko/studio, studio-core, studio-kit, studio-mcp). The server is closed.

scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && node --test packages/*/test/*.test.* && npm run test:studio
scripts.test:studio: npm test -w studio/packages/cli -w studio/packages/voice -w studio/packages/review -w studio/packages/publish -w studio/packages/hyperframes -w studio/packages/core -w studio/packages/kit -w studio/packages/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/sdk -w packages/core -w packages/cli -w studio/packages/core -w studio/packages/kit -w studio/packages/voice -w studio/packages/review -w studio/packages/publish -w studio/packages/hyperframes -w studio/packages/cli -w studio/packages/mcp
